llm.summary: This fal.ai skill is a disclosed connector wrapper that uses OOMOL's oo CLI and does not show artifact-backed malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is coherent: it routes fal.ai read and queue-management actions through the OOMOL fal_ai connector, with actions listed and state-changing cancellation marked as write.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime authority is scoped to Bash commands matching oo *, and the instructions require fetching live schemas before calls and confirming exact payloads before write or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes curl-to-bash and PowerShell irm-to-iex installer commands for the oo CLI, but they are disclosed, one-time fallback steps rather than hidden automatic execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires an OOMOL-connected fal.ai account and server-side credentials; that is expected for the integration, but users should remember fal.ai actions may incur account or billing impact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background persistence or privilege escalation is shown; persistent effects are limited to normal CLI installation, OOMOL sign-in, and account connection setup if the user performs them.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want Codex to operate fal.ai through your OOMOL account. Review write actions such as request cancellation before approval, and consider installing the oo CLI through a verified method rather than piping an installer directly to your shell.
